title: pentaphyllum norvegicum
intro: Pentaphyllum norvegicum, commonly known as Torreya norvegica, is a plant species in the yew family, characterized by its unique foliage and woody stems. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Pentaphyllum norvegicum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids and flavonoids, which may help to modulate immune responses and exhibit neuroprotective effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and therapeutic potential of this plant.
